## Core Technology

Bolt.new is built on StackBlitz WebContainer technology, which runs a full Node.js environment directly in the browser. WebContainers is a WebAssembly-based "microoperating system" that can run Vite operations and the entire Node.js ecosystem in the browser.

## Frontend & Build Tools

The AI generates React, Next.js, Vite, or plain Node.js projects, and the WebContainer executes them in real-time so you can see changes instantly. Built-in integrations include React, Vue, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, Remix, Supabase, Stripe, GitHub, and Netlify.

## Backend & Database Integration

For backend functionality, most Bolt.new apps integrate with Supabase (database, auth, storage) or use serverless API routes deployed alongside the frontend.

## Deployment

When you deploy a Bolt.new project, the code is pushed to Netlify or Vercel. The typical deployment is a static site (React SPA) with serverless functions for any server-side logic. You can deploy using Netlify, Vercel, or Cloudflare in one click from the browser.

## Development Environment

Code compilation, bundling, and preview all happen client-side without a remote server. Bolt.new supports npm package installation, file system operations, and terminal commands – all within the browser sandbox.
